subject.title: fix(gateway): regenerate native hook descriptors when relay unavailable after restart

question: Which native-relay failures may safely fall back to runBeforeToolCallHook instead of failing closed?
rationale: Current merged behavior deliberately fails closed for unknown unavailable PreToolUse state, while this PR catches every relay or deferred-approval error; the permanent error classification and enforcement boundary require explicit owner confirmation.

options.title: Narrow to transport failures
options.body: Fallback only for recognized missing, expired, or restart-generation relay conditions and retain fail-closed behavior for policy, approval-state, parsing, and unexpected failures.

options.title: Accept broad fallback
options.body: Allow every native-relay invocation failure to rerun normal before-tool policy, accepting that native-only relay work may be skipped.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Retain current app-server denial behavior and limit this PR to retrying stale direct bridges through the generation-gated gateway.

recommendation.title: Narrow to transport failures
recommendation.body: Fallback only for recognized missing, expired, or restart-generation relay conditions and retain fail-closed behavior for policy, approval-state, parsing, and unexpected failures.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work from this contributor most directly defines current relay generation, replacement, and recovery semantics.
